comparison.objective: Drain liquid from a pan while retaining dumplings with an ajar lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate lid gap control with pan tilting and pouring.
comparison.success_condition: Specified drained volume and retained solids, with pan returned upright to the stove.
comparison.reason: Bimanual force coordination is generic; selective pouring and spill retention do not exercise fastener manipulation, collar tuning, or post-lock dynamic verification.
